gen-press-start-2p-gf-michroma: Michroma gives every letter a wide berth, a plain sans with stubby ascenders. Press Start 2P brings the retro fun up top, its pinned-apart letters and faint pen-like thickening making the clearest difference against that spaced-out body.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-miriam-libre: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart. Miriam Libre follows with a wire-thin line and tall, sturdy lowercase, so a longer passage moves along smoothly with no brush-like swelling.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart, like cut-outs on a board, with only faint modulation. And Mochiy Pop One, a sans-serif with a very large lowercase eye, holds the text in curves that never thin at the shoulders.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Chunky pixel fun, with letters pinned far apart and a slight thick-and-thin hidden in the curves. Mochiy Pop P One, a sans with one flat line weight throughout, gives it a steady footing.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-montserrat-underli: Round bowls with walls that never swell or taper give Montserrat Underline a steady, oversized lowercase look. Montserrat Underline keeps a longer passage moving easily, while Press Start 2P above it adds soft contrast and retro fun.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mozilla-headline: Friendly and modern, Mozilla Headline fills its lines with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal. But Press Start 2P, with its mild thick-and-thin rhythm and pinned-apart letters, keeps a longer read feeling playful and retro.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text looks bold because its lowercase bodies run so tall. Press Start 2P adds retro fun above, its modest modulation and far-apart letters set against flared terminals below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads with a large central band and wide, unclosed curves, traced like a technical pen. But Press Start 2P does the playful retro work, with subtle etched-glass weight changes, while the sans-serif body handles steady text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-nobile: Press Start 2P has stems just heavier than its hairlines. Nobile, a sans-serif with open letter mouths and little gap between x-height and caps, gives that retro fun a tidy, contemporary partner.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-nokora: Retro fun with a wink, thanks to measured thread-against-yarn weight in Press Start 2P. And Nokora, a plain sans with a wide-open s, lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line.
